ans/wa는 알 수 없다. 오직 본문 단서와 문법 지식만으로 판단.

fullPassage: Dear Homeowner / Resident: Beginning around mid-April, 2017, contractors for the City of Southfield will perform water main and pavement replacement in your area. The proposed road improvements are made possible thanks to the City's $99 million Street Improvements Bond which was approved by voters in 2016. The water main will be replaced under the water fund.
